title: Micro Storage Drawer
body:
"A tiny drawer for all of your storage needs! Allows you to store items within the structure. Micro Storage drawers have a limit of 50 per drawer, and only allow the same item & type to be stored per drawer. With logic, an input of 100 can toggle the input lock on the drawer (50 to disable). An input from 1 to 10 will attempt to output x amount of it's contents."

The Micro Storage Drawer is a structure that can be used to store up to 50 of a single item. They can be bought at Jerry's Junk shop beside the Lighthouse for 6,700$ each.
